kaikki_vikisozluk.e: نَوْبَة • (nawba) f (plural نَوْبَات (nawbāt) or نُوَب (nuwab))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Verbal noun of the verb نَابَ (nāba, “to afflict, to occur”). The sense of a troupe of musicians is probably a semantic loan from Ottoman Turkish نوبت (nevbet, nöbet).
s: semantic loan from Ottoman Turkish نوبت (nevbet, nöbet)
g: change of the guard, guard duty
troupe of musicians, small native orchestra
